Mixed purées

Pineapple with curd

Túrós ananász

8 months+ Adjusted 10 min 2 portions

A small bowl from eight months. Stop if it stings, and try less another week. This contains milk.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 30 g very ripe pineapple (fresh flesh, core removed, not canned in syrup)
  • 100 g pasteurised full-fat curd or cottage cheese (no added salt if you can find it; milk allergen)
  • 40 g plain pasteurised full-fat yogurt (to loosen the curd)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Cut the core and skin off a very ripe pineapple and take a small piece of flesh.
  2. Chop that flesh very fine, with no fibrous threads.
  3. Stir the yogurt into the curd.
  4. Fold the pineapple through the curd.
  5. Do not add sugar, and do not offer this as a first purée.

Adjusted

Pineapple can sting a baby's mouth, so this is not a first purée. It is often delayed until 11 months without a good reason.

Use only a small amount of very ripe pineapple, chopped very fine, folded into curd and yogurt. Age 8 is enough, so do not wait until 11 months.
